description: This file defines a class for an OpenCart module 'Latest' which displays latest products on a storefront. It contains a method 'index' that loads product data, processes images, prices, and generates HTML output for the latest products.

classes.name: Latest
classes.description: Controller class for the 'Latest' products module, responsible for retrieving and rendering latest product data.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method to gather latest products data, process images and prices, and render the output view.
